products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate properties such as apartment buildings, industrial properties, office buildings, warehouses, and retail facilities, primarily in New Jersey. These loans are underwritten and serviced by in-person staff and require regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of one-to four-family residential mortgage loans, primarily held in portfolio and secured by properties in the local market. Loans are underwritten according to Freddie Mac guidelines and require in-person human labor and regulated processes.

products.name: Construction and Land Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for construction and land acquisition for development of residential homes, apartment buildings, and commercial properties. These loans are typically short-term, involve physical site inspections, and are serviced by in-person staff.

products.name: Home Equity Loans and Lines of Credit
products.description: Origination of home equity loans and revolving lines of credit secured by residential properties in the local market. These are underwritten based on credit history and collateral value, and serviced through branch infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial Business Lending (including SBA Loans)
products.description: Origination of commercial business loans, including term loans, revolving lines of credit, and SBA 7(a) loans, to small and mid-sized businesses for working capital, equipment, or real estate. These loans are underwritten and serviced by in-person staff and require regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a range of deposit accounts to retail and business customers, including demand accounts, NOW accounts, money market accounts, savings accounts, retirement accounts, and certificates of deposit. These are delivered through physical branches and digital channels.

products.name: Investment Securities Portfolio
products.description: Investment in and management of securities such as U.S. Treasury obligations, mortgage-backed securities, government-sponsored enterprise obligations, corporate debt, and municipal debt. This is managed by the bank for its own account, not as a service to external customers.

products.name: Non-Deposit Investment and Financial Planning Services
products.description: Provision of non-deposit investment products and financial planning services, including insurance products, annuities, and retirement planning, to individual and commercial customers through a dedicated subsidiary. Delivered via in-person advisors and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Alcoholic Beverages E-Commerce Platform
products.description: An online marketplace (CWSpirits.com) offering a wide selection of spirits, wines, champagnes, and related alcohol products from various brands, delivered to customers across the United States. The platform is digital-only, leveraging e-commerce infrastructure and third-party logistics for fulfillment and distribution.

products.name: SWOL Tequila Brand
products.description: A proprietary line of premium, limited-edition tequilas (including Añejo, Peach, and Cristalino) produced in Mexico, bottled and branded under the SWOL trademark, and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels. Production involves contracted manufacturing, importation, and compliance with tequila standards.

products.name: Alcohol Brand Marketing Services
products.description: Marketing agency services for third-party alcohol brands, including digital campaigns, influencer marketing, banner ads, email campaigns, and product placement on the CWS Platform. Delivered via in-house expertise and a network of industry influencers, typically on a monthly fee basis.

products.name: Vault Membership Program
products.description: A paid subscription service for CWS Platform customers, providing exclusive benefits such as discounts, free shipping, loyalty points, and special offers. Delivered digitally through the e-commerce platform, generating recurring monthly revenue.

products.name: Third-Party Alcohol Brand Sales
products.description: Sales of alcoholic beverages from third-party brands (e.g., Loca Loka, Pinaq, Don Ramon, Soda Jerk, Full Bore Whiskey) through the CWS Platform, leveraging e-commerce infrastructure and logistics partners for fulfillment. Includes small batch and craft spirits.

products.name: Non-Alcoholic and Ready-to-Drink (RTD) Beverages
products.description: Minority investment and participation in the sale and marketing of non-alcoholic and ready-to-drink beverages (e.g., through Chase Mocktails Ltd.), leveraging growth in these beverage categories. Delivered via e-commerce and distribution partnerships.

products.name: Wine Production and Sales (Cannon Estate Winery)
products.description: Minority stake in Cannon Estate Winery, a physical winery producing and selling a variety of wines from estate-grown grapes, with expansion into online sales and cross-border marketing. Delivered through traditional winery operations and digital marketing.

products.name: Homebuilding Services
products.description: Construction and sale of single-family detached homes, townhomes, and condominiums, primarily on a pre-sold basis, using independent subcontractors for physical construction across multiple metropolitan areas.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Origination and sale of mortgage loans exclusively for homebuyers purchasing NVR-built homes, including processing, underwriting, and selling loans into secondary markets, operated through a wholly owned subsidiary.

products.name: Title and Settlement Services
products.description: Provision of title insurance brokerage and title search services for homebuyers, generating commissions and fees, delivered through separate subsidiaries within the mortgage banking operations.

products.name: Mixed-Signal Microcontrollers and Microprocessors
products.description: Proprietary general purpose and specialized 8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit, and 64-bit mixed-signal microcontrollers and microprocessors, manufactured using advanced semiconductor processes and delivered as integrated circuits for embedded control applications across various industries.

products.name: Analog Semiconductor Products
products.description: A range of analog integrated circuits including power management, linear, mixed-signal, high voltage, thermal management, RF, drivers, safety, security, timing, USB, ethernet, wireless and other interface products, manufactured and sold as discrete or integrated solutions for embedded systems.

products.name: Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs)
products.description: Non-volatile FPGAs recognized for low power, high security, and extended reliability, manufactured and sold for use in industrial, automotive, defense, aviation, space, and communications applications.

products.name: Memory Products
products.description: EEPROMs, Serial Flash, Parallel Flash, Serial SRAM, and EERAM memory devices, manufactured and sold primarily for embedded control markets to complement microcontroller offerings.

products.name: Technology Licensing and Royalties
products.description: Licensing of proprietary technologies such as SuperFlash embedded flash and non-volatile memory to third parties, generating license fees and royalties from foundries, device manufacturers, and design partners worldwide.

products.name: Engineering Services
products.description: Provision of engineering services related to technology licensing, including design, product, test, and reliability support for licensees and partners.

products.name: Development Tools for Embedded Systems
products.description: Comprehensive set of hardware and software development tools, including compilers, code configurators, simulators, and in-circuit emulation systems, sold to enable customers to program and develop applications using the company's microcontrollers, FPGAs, and microprocessors.

products.name: Manufacturing Services (Wafer Foundry and Assembly/Test Subcontracting)
products.description: Provision of wafer fabrication, assembly, and test services to external customers as subcontracted manufacturing offerings, leveraging internal semiconductor manufacturing capabilities.

products.name: Legacy Application Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs) and Aerospace Products
products.description: Legacy ASICs and specialized products for aerospace applications, manufactured and sold to customers in niche and long-lifecycle markets.

products.name: Omnipod Insulin Delivery Systems
products.description: A family of proprietary, tubeless, wearable insulin pumps (including Omnipod 5, Omnipod DASH, and Classic Omnipod) that provide continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion for people with insulin-dependent diabetes. These devices are manufactured in-house and integrate with third-party continuous glucose monitors and mobile apps for automated insulin delivery and data management.

products.name: Drug Delivery Pods for Pharmaceutical Partners
products.description: Manufactured pods used as part of drug delivery kits for pharmaceutical companies, such as Amgen's Neulasta Onpro kit, enabling automated subcutaneous delivery of non-insulin medications. These pods are produced using Insulet's proprietary technology and manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Diabetes Data Management and Analytics Platforms
products.description: Cloud-based digital platforms and applications (such as Omnipod Discover and Glooko integration) that provide users, caregivers, and healthcare providers with actionable insights, trend analysis, and remote access to insulin delivery and glucose data. These services are delivered digitally and support Omnipod device users.

products.name: Melanocortin Receptor Agonists for Obesity and Metabolic Disorders
products.description: Pharmaceutical products based on MC4R agonist peptides and small molecules, developed through chemical synthesis and rational drug design, administered orally or by injection for the treatment of obesity, metabolic-related disorders, rare MC4R pathway diseases, and orphan indications. These products require extensive clinical development and regulatory approval.

products.name: Melanocortin Receptor Agonists for Inflammatory and Autoimmune Diseases
products.description: Therapeutic peptides and small molecules, primarily MC1R agonists, developed via synthetic chemistry and drug design, administered orally or topically, for the treatment of inflammatory and autoimmune diseases such as dry eye disease, uveitis, diabetic retinopathy, inflammatory bowel disease, and diabetic nephropathy. These products are delivered through oral formulations or topical solutions and require regulatory approval.

products.name: Melanocortin Receptor Agonists for Sexual Dysfunction
products.description: Pharmaceutical products, including FDA-approved and investigational melanocortin receptor agonists, developed through peptide synthesis and drug design, administered via subcutaneous injection or other routes, for the treatment of sexual dysfunction such as hypoactive sexual desire disorder (HSDD) in women and erectile dysfunction (ED) in men. These products are delivered through auto-injectors or co-formulations with other agents.

products.name: Convenient Foods
products.description: Manufactured and distributed globally, this line includes snacks (chips, granola bars), cereals, oatmeal, pasta, rice, dips, and spreads under brands such as Lay’s, Doritos, Cheetos, Quaker, Ruffles, Tostitos, and Sabra. Products are produced in company-owned or third-party facilities and delivered via direct-store-delivery, warehouse, and distributor networks.

products.name: Non-Alcoholic Beverages
products.description: This line includes carbonated soft drinks, bottled water, sports drinks, energy drinks, juice drinks, and ready-to-drink teas and coffees, produced in company-owned or franchised bottling plants and distributed globally under brands such as Pepsi, Mountain Dew, Gatorade, Aquafina, 7UP, Mirinda, Lipton, and Starbucks.

products.name: SodaStream Sparkling Water Makers and Related Products
products.description: Manufactured and distributed globally, this line includes SodaStream home carbonation devices and related consumables, enabling consumers to make sparkling water and flavored beverages at home. Products are sold through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Dairy Products
products.description: Produced and distributed primarily in EMEA, this line includes branded dairy products such as Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne, manufactured in company-owned or third-party facilities and sold through retail and distributor networks.

products.name: Licensed and Distributed Beverage Brands
products.description: PepsiCo manufactures and/or distributes certain beverage brands owned by third parties (e.g., Dr Pepper, Crush, Schweppes, Celsius, Alani Nu, Rockstar, Dole, Ocean Spray) under license or distribution agreements, leveraging its bottling and distribution infrastructure.

products.name: New Vehicle Sales and Leasing
products.description: Sale and lease of new cars and light trucks through franchised dealerships and digital platforms, involving physical inventory, regulated franchise agreements, and in-person or online transactions.

products.name: Used Vehicle Sales
products.description: Retail and wholesale of used vehicles to customers at dealerships, via digital platforms, and through third-party auctions, requiring physical inventory management and reconditioning.

products.name: Vehicle Financing and Insurance (F&I) Products
products.description: Arrangement of vehicle financing and sale of service and insurance contracts in connection with vehicle sales, delivered through dealership staff and digital tools, involving third-party financial institutions and regulated disclosures.

products.name: Automotive Maintenance and Repair Services
products.description: Provision of warranty and non-warranty maintenance and repair services for vehicles at franchised dealerships, requiring factory-trained technicians, regulated facilities, and in-person labor.

products.name: Collision Repair Services
products.description: Repair of vehicles damaged in collisions at dedicated collision centers, involving specialized equipment, skilled labor, and compliance with safety and environmental regulations.

products.name: Retail and Wholesale Vehicle Parts Sales
products.description: Sale of replacement and aftermarket vehicle parts and accessories to retail and wholesale customers, both at dealerships and through distribution channels, requiring inventory management and logistics.

products.name: Accident & Health Insurance
products.description: Insurance products designed to meet the risk management needs of diverse populations, including employer groups, associations, affinity groups, higher education, and other niche markets. Delivered through program management, underwriting guidance, and partnerships with brokers, MGAs, and insurtechs. Includes international medical insurance, travel insurance, and trip insurance, with services such as medical management and emergency assistance.

products.name: Property & Casualty Insurance
products.description: Primary insurance coverage for property and casualty risks, including professional liability and commercial auto lines, delivered globally through program administrators and MGAs. Requires underwriting expertise, regulated infrastructure, and is written on admitted, non-admitted, and Lloyd’s paper.

products.name: Other Specialty Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage for specialized risks including Aviation & Space, Credit, Surety, Marine & Energy, and Mortgage. Delivered globally, often through MGAs and program administrators, requiring specialized underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Casualty Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance products for casualty insurers covering a broad range of casualty classes, including commercial casualty lines, professional liability, and specialty niche classes. Delivered globally, primarily through treaty reinsurance (proportional and excess of loss) and some facultative reinsurance, requiring significant underwriting and actuarial expertise.

products.name: Property Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance products providing catastrophe protection and worldwide coverage for natural perils, including residential, commercial, and industrial property risks. Delivered through treaty and facultative reinsurance, supported by catastrophe modeling and actuarial analysis.

products.name: Other Specialty Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance coverage for specialized risks such as Aviation & Space, Marine & Energy, and Credit, delivered globally through proportional and excess of loss, treaty and facultative reinsurance. Requires specialized underwriting and risk assessment.

products.name: Service Fee Income from Managing General Agents (MGAs)
products.description: Service fee income generated from consolidated MGAs, including program management, underwriting, and administrative services for insurance products. Delivered through ownership or partnership with MGAs, providing diversification of earnings and less exposure to underwriting cycle volatility.

products.name: Wearable Insulin Pump Systems (MODD1 and Pivot)
products.description: A line of wearable insulin pump systems, including the MODD1 and its successor Pivot, designed for people with diabetes requiring multiple daily doses of insulin. These devices are physically manufactured medical devices that deliver both basal and bolus insulin, featuring a modular design with reusable and disposable components, and are distributed after regulatory clearance. The Pivot model is a tubeless, patch-style pump with integrated infusion set and optional smartphone connectivity.

products.name: Disposable Insulin Pump Consumables (Cartridges and Infusion Sets)
products.description: Disposable cartridges and infusion sets designed for use with the company's insulin pump systems. These are physical, single-use components that hold insulin and deliver it to the patient, requiring regular replacement (every three days for cartridges/sets), and are manufactured and packaged for sale alongside the pumps.

products.name: Insulin Pump Software and Digital Integration
products.description: Software applications and digital integration features for insulin pump users, including phone-based control, Bluetooth/NFC connectivity, and future Automated Insulin Delivery (AID) and ACE (Alternative Controller Enabled) capabilities. These are digital products delivered via mobile devices to enhance pump usability and integration with continuous glucose monitors (CGMs).

products.name: Complete Automotive Seat Systems
products.description: Design, development, engineering, assembly, and just-in-time delivery of fully assembled seat systems for light vehicles, tailored to specific vehicle models or platforms. Production involves high-precision manufacturing, vertical integration of key components, and global just-in-time logistics.

products.name: Automotive Seat Components
products.description: Manufacture and supply of key seat components including seat trim covers, surface materials (leather and fabric), seat mechanisms, seat cushioning, headrests, and thermal comfort systems (heating, ventilation, active cooling, pneumatic lumbar, massage). Components are produced using advanced materials, automated processes, and are integrated into seat systems or sold separately.

products.name: Thermal Comfort Systems for Automotive Seating
products.description: Development and manufacture of thermal comfort systems for vehicle seats, including seat heating, ventilation, active cooling, pneumatic lumbar, and massage products. These systems are integrated into seat modules or supplied as standalone modules, leveraging electronics, sensors, and proprietary algorithms.

products.name: Automotive Leather and Fabric Materials
products.description: Production and supply of premium automotive leather and fabric materials, including sustainable and performance textiles, for seat covers and interior applications. Manufacturing involves tanning, finishing, and advanced textile processes, with a focus on sustainability and customization.

products.name: Automotive Electrical Distribution and Connection Systems
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacture of complete electrical distribution and connection systems for vehicles, including wire harnesses, terminals, connectors, high-voltage battery connection systems, and engineered components. Production uses automated assembly, stamping, molding, and is tailored for both low- and high-voltage architectures.

products.name: High-Voltage Power Distribution Products (including BDUs)
products.description: Development and manufacture of high-voltage power distribution products, including battery disconnect units (BDUs), which control and manage the flow of high-voltage power in electric and hybrid vehicles. Production involves advanced power and thermal management, electrical integration, and automated assembly.

products.name: Low-Voltage Power Distribution Products and Electronic Controllers
products.description: Design and manufacture of low-voltage power distribution units and electronic controllers (e.g., zonal controllers, body domain modules, smart and passive power distribution modules) with embedded software for managing vehicle functions and power distribution. Production uses specialized electronics assembly and software integration.

products.name: Engineered Plastic Components for Automotive Electrical Applications
products.description: Manufacture of engineered plastic components used in automotive electrical distribution systems, such as molded parts for protection, routing, sealing, or covering within wire harness assemblies. Production uses injection molding and automated processes.

products.name: Sustainable Automotive Materials (e.g., FlexAir®, ReNewKnit®, SoyFoamTM)
products.description: Development and supply of sustainable automotive materials, including recyclable non-foam alternatives (FlexAir®), recycled-content textiles (ReNewKnit®), and bio-based foams (SoyFoamTM), for use in seating and interior applications. Production involves proprietary material science and sustainable manufacturing processes.

products.name: Generic Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and sale of generic medicines in various dosage forms (tablets, capsules, liquids, ointments, creams), produced in GMP-certified facilities and distributed globally through wholesale and retail channels.

products.name: Branded Nutraceuticals
products.description: Manufacture and sale of proprietary nutraceutical products (Sky Premium Life®, Mediterranation®) including vitamins, minerals, amino acids, herbal extracts, and specialized formulas, produced in-house and distributed through retail, wholesale, and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Biocides and Antiseptic Soaps
products.description: Production and sale of branded biocides and antiseptic soaps (C-Sept®, C-Scrub®) with broad-spectrum antimicrobial formulations, manufactured in compliance with WHO standards and distributed to healthcare providers and consumers.

products.name: Medical Devices
products.description: Development and sale of medical devices such as Otikon™ ear drops (class II medical device), produced using natural ingredients and distributed to pharmacies and healthcare providers.

products.name: Infant Nutrition and Care Products
products.description: Production and sale of organic infant nutrition and care products under the Bio-bebe® brand, including baby foods, cereals, cosmetics, and detergents, made from organic ingredients and distributed through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Telehealth Services
products.description: Provision of direct-to-consumer telemedicine services via the ZipDoctor platform, offering subscription-based, 24/7 virtual access to physicians and mental health counselors through phone or video chat.

products.name: Drug Repurposing Platform
products.description: AI-driven drug repurposing services using the Cloudscreen® platform, integrating data analysis and in vitro validation to identify new therapeutic uses for existing drugs, offered to pharmaceutical partners and researchers.

products.name: Innovative Oncology and Specialty Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Development and commercialization of novel, patented medicines for oncology (CNS, prostate, ovarian, colorectal cancers) and specialty indications (obesity, gastrointestinal disorders), produced through advanced R&D and clinical trials for global markets.

products.name: Pharmaceutical and Healthcare Product Distribution
products.description: Full-line wholesale distribution of pharmaceutical products, OTC drugs, medical devices, nutraceuticals, and healthcare products to pharmacies, hospitals, clinics, and other distributors, utilizing advanced automated warehousing and logistics systems.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing and Development Services (CMO/CDMO)
products.description: Provision of contract manufacturing and development services for pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, cosmetics, biocides, and medical devices to third-party clients, leveraging GMP-certified facilities and regulatory expertise.

products.name: Restaurant Food Service
products.description: Sweetgreen operates owned and branded restaurants that serve healthy, customizable salads, bowls, and plates, prepared in-house using high-quality ingredients. Food is produced and delivered through physical restaurant locations, with options for dine-in, carry-out, and digital ordering.

products.name: Digital Ordering and Delivery Services
products.description: Sweetgreen offers digital ordering through owned channels and third-party platforms, enabling customers to order food for pickup or delivery. This service is delivered via digital infrastructure and partnerships with delivery providers.

products.name: Catering Services
products.description: Sweetgreen provides catering services for group orders, allowing customers to order larger quantities of menu items for events or gatherings. Catering is fulfilled through restaurant operations and delivery logistics.

products.name: Residential Roofing Accessories and Rainwater Management Systems
products.description: Manufactures and supplies roofing accessories (trim, coil, flashings, soffit, fascia), gutters, downspouts, gutter protection, roof drainage accessories, and related products for residential and light commercial housing. Products are produced using galvanized and painted steel, aluminum, and plastics, delivered through manufacturing facilities and distribution channels.

products.name: Roof and Foundation Ventilation Products
products.description: Produces and supplies ventilation products for roofs and building foundations to support healthy home environments. These are manufactured using metal and plastic components and distributed through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Mail and Package Delivery Solutions
products.description: Designs and manufactures single point and centralized mail systems, including mailboxes and cluster style mail and parcel boxes, providing secure storage for mail and package deliveries for residential and multi-family housing. Products are manufactured from metal and plastics and distributed to property managers and postal service providers.

products.name: Outdoor Living Space Products (Retractable Awnings)
products.description: Manufactures and supplies retractable awnings for sun and wind protection in residential and light commercial settings. Products are produced using metal, fabric, and mechanical components and distributed through retail and contractor channels.

products.name: Controlled Environment Agriculture Facilities and Greenhouses
products.description: Designs, engineers, manufactures, and constructs highly-automated controlled environment agriculture (CEA) facilities and custom greenhouses for commercial growers, research institutions, and retail applications. Delivery includes turnkey construction, integration of subsystems, and installation, requiring engineering, manufacturing, and field labor.

products.name: Structural Canopies for Retail and Commercial Applications
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and installs structural canopies for fuel stations, car washes, convenience stores, travel centers, food retail, EV charging stations, and quick serve restaurants. Delivery includes engineering, manufacturing, and full-scope construction, often tailored for optimal traffic flow and shelter.

products.name: Engineered Infrastructure Products for Bridges, Highways, and Airfields
products.description: Manufactures and supplies engineered products such as structural bearings, expansion joints, pavement seals, elastomeric concrete, and bridge cable protection systems for bridge, highway, and airport construction and repair. Products are made from steel, resin, and rubber materials, requiring specialized manufacturing and engineering to meet regulatory codes.

products.name: Equity and Equity-Related Investments in Private, Venture-Backed Companies
products.description: SuRo Capital provides external investors with access to a portfolio of non-controlling equity and equity-related investments (including common stock, preferred stock, warrants, options, and convertible debt) in rapidly growing, venture capital-backed private companies, primarily in technology and related sectors. These investments are sourced through direct investments, secondary marketplaces, and investment funds or SPVs, and are managed as a diversified portfolio for capital appreciation.

products.name: Debt Investments in Private Companies
products.description: SuRo Capital makes debt investments, including convertible debt securities with significant equity components, in emerging private companies. These investments are typically structured to provide potential capital gains and, to a lesser extent, income, and are managed as part of the overall investment portfolio.

products.name: Equity Investments in Publicly Traded Companies
products.description: SuRo Capital opportunistically invests in select publicly traded equity securities, including those of companies that have recently gone public or meet the firm's investment criteria. These investments are managed alongside private company holdings to provide liquidity and diversification.

products.name: Managerial Assistance Services to Portfolio Companies
products.description: As required by its status as a business development company, SuRo Capital offers and may provide significant managerial assistance to its portfolio companies, including board participation, consulting, and organizational or financial guidance. These services may be provided for a fee, subject to board review.

products.name: Truckload Transportation Services
products.description: Asset-based transportation of general commodities using company-owned or contracted trucks and trailers, including dedicated, expedited, automotive, local, regional, and long-haul services across the U.S., Mexico, and Canada. Requires physical fleet operations, driver labor, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Brokerage and Logistics Services
products.description: Coordination and facilitation of freight transportation for customers using third-party carriers and equipment, expanding capacity beyond company-owned assets. Delivered through logistics management and digital/telephonic coordination.

products.name: TULSA-PRO System
products.description: An AI-powered, MRI-guided, incision-free medical device system for the ablation of benign or malignant prostate tissue, including cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). The system consists of capital equipment and one-time-use disposable devices, and is delivered via a transurethral catheter with real-time MRI thermometry and robotically controlled ultrasound energy. Requires physical manufacturing, regulated infrastructure, and is used in clinical settings by physicians.

products.name: Sonalleve System
products.description: A medical device system that uses MRI-guided, externally delivered focused ultrasound for incision-free ablation of diseased tissue, including uterine fibroids, adenomyosis, palliative relief of pain from bone metastases, treatment of osteoid osteoma, and management of benign desmoid tumors. The system is capital equipment integrated with MRI scanners and is used in hospitals and imaging centers. Requires physical manufacturing, regulated infrastructure, and is delivered by trained clinicians.

products.name: Obexelimab Immunology Franchise
products.description: A bifunctional monoclonal antibody therapy targeting CD19 and FcγRIIb, developed and delivered as an intravenous or subcutaneous injection for the treatment of multiple autoimmune diseases, including IgG4-related disease, relapsing multiple sclerosis, and systemic lupus erythematosus. Requires biologics manufacturing, clinical development, and regulatory approval.

products.name: Orelabrutinib for Multiple Sclerosis
products.description: An oral, CNS-penetrant Bruton’s Tyrosine Kinase (BTK) inhibitor developed for the treatment of progressive forms of multiple sclerosis, including primary progressive and non-active secondary progressive MS. Delivered as an oral small molecule, requiring chemical synthesis and clinical development.

products.name: ZB021 (Oral IL-17AA/AF Inhibitor)
products.description: An oral small molecule inhibitor targeting IL-17AA and IL-17AF signaling, designed for the treatment of immune-mediated diseases in rheumatology and dermatology. Requires chemical synthesis and clinical development.

products.name: ZB022 (Oral Brain-Penetrant TYK2 Inhibitor)
products.description: An oral, brain-penetrant small molecule inhibitor of TYK2-JH2, intended for immune-mediated and neuroinflammatory diseases. Currently in preclinical/early clinical development, requiring chemical synthesis and regulatory approval.

products.name: ZB002 (Anti-TNFα Monoclonal Antibody)
products.description: A monoclonal antibody therapy targeting TNFα with extended half-life, developed for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Delivered as a biologic injection, requiring advanced biologics manufacturing and clinical trials.

products.name: ZB004 (CTLA-4-Ig Fusion Protein)
products.description: A CTLA-4-Ig fusion protein with extended half-life, designed for the treatment of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Delivered as a biologic injection, requiring biologics manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: ZB001 (Anti-IGF-1R Monoclonal Antibody, Greater China)
products.description: A monoclonal antibody targeting IGF-1R, licensed for development and commercialization in Greater China for the treatment of thyroid eye disease and related indications. Delivered as a biologic injection, requiring biologics manufacturing and regional regulatory approval.

products.name: Single-Family Home Rentals
products.description: Leasing and managing single-family homes as rental properties, developed or acquired by the company, delivered through in-house property management and digital leasing platforms.

products.name: Built-for-Rental Home Development
products.description: Development and construction of new single-family homes specifically designed and built for rental purposes, managed by an internal development team and delivered as ready-to-lease properties.

products.name: Property Acquisition and Renovation Services
products.description: Acquisition of existing single-family homes and renovation to prepare them for rental, involving property evaluation, contractor management, and quality control, delivered through internal teams and local contractors.

products.name: Property Management Services for Joint Ventures
products.description: Providing property management services for single-family homes held in unconsolidated joint ventures, including leasing, maintenance, and tenant relations, delivered through the company's internal management platform.

products.name: Industrial Metals Distribution
products.description: Distribution of a full line of carbon steel, stainless steel, alloy steels, aluminum, and a limited line of nickel and red metals in various shapes such as coils, sheets, bars, plates, structurals, and tubing. Products are sourced in bulk and sold in smaller quantities to customers across diverse industries, leveraging a large network of service centers and logistics capabilities.

products.name: Value-Added Metals Processing and Fabrication Services
products.description: Provision of metals processing and fabrication services such as bending, cutting, machining, welding, laser cutting, and other techniques to customize metals to specific customer requirements. These services require specialized equipment and are performed at service centers to deliver processed metals with specified thickness, length, width, shape, and surface quality.

products.name: Supply Chain and Inventory Management Solutions
products.description: Provision of supply chain solutions including just-in-time delivery, inventory management, and logistics services to help customers manage working capital and ensure timely delivery of metals and processed products. These services leverage the company's network of facilities, in-house and dedicated truck fleet, and analytics-driven inventory management systems.

products.name: OST-HER2 Immunotherapy
products.description: A genetically engineered, off-the-shelf cancer immunotherapy based on an attenuated strain of Listeria monocytogenes expressing HER2 peptides, delivered via intravenous infusion for the treatment of Osteosarcoma and other HER2-expressing solid tumors. Manufactured using synthetic processes and contract manufacturing organizations under GMP standards.

products.name: OST-tADC Tunable Drug Conjugate Platform
products.description: A next-generation antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) platform utilizing tunable pH-sensitive silicone dioxide linkers (SiLinkers) to deliver cytotoxic payloads, including chemotherapeutics and potentially mRNA, to solid tumors. The platform is in preclinical development and is manufactured through chemical synthesis and contract research organizations.

products.name: OST-HER2 for Veterinary Use
products.description: A version of the OST-HER2 immunotherapy developed for the treatment of canine Osteosarcoma, previously conditionally licensed for veterinary use and potentially out-licensed to animal health companies. Manufactured similarly to the human product, using contract manufacturing organizations.

products.name: Radio Advertising Services
products.description: Sale of advertising time on owned and operated FM and AM radio stations across multiple markets, delivered via traditional broadcast infrastructure and supported by local sales teams and programming staff.

products.name: Digital Advertising Services
products.description: Provision of digital marketing solutions including paid search, targeted display, streaming, social media, online video, website-based advertising, and on-line news, delivered through digital platforms and managed by centralized and local digital specialists.

products.name: Integrated Marketing Campaigns
products.description: Coordinated advertising campaigns that combine broadcast radio with digital marketing services, leveraging both traditional and digital channels to maximize advertiser reach and engagement, managed by local sales teams and digital specialists.

products.name: On-line News Services
products.description: Digital news content and advertising opportunities provided through online platforms, produced and distributed via digital infrastructure and included as part of digital marketing offerings.

products.name: Health and Wellness Supplements
products.description: Nutritional supplements and health food products designed to assist in cell metabolism, detoxification, blood circulation, anti-aging, and overall health, primarily sourced from third parties, rebranded, and distributed via network marketing and direct sales channels.

products.name: Wellness Programs and Advisory Services
products.description: Comprehensive wellness programs and health solution advisory services, including the ATP Zeta Health Program, which combines supplements, nutrition, and advice from dieticians, delivered through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Complementary Health Therapies
products.description: Provision of complementary and traditional health therapies, including proprietary formulas for treating non-communicable diseases and traditional complementary medicine, delivered through physical locations and health screening-based prescriptions.

products.name: Skin Care and Personal Care Products
products.description: Skin care and healthcare products offered alongside training courses, distributed through wellness promotion subsidiaries and direct sales channels.

products.name: Wellness Lifestyle Promotion Services
products.description: Services promoting wellness and wellbeing lifestyle, including online editorials, programs, events, and campaigns, delivered both digitally and in-person to educate and engage the community.

products.name: Digital Wellness Platform
products.description: A digital platform integrating e-commerce, online consultations, chronic disease management, and supply chain services for wellness products, developed in collaboration with IT partners and targeting the ASEAN market.

products.name: Renewable Energy Solutions
products.description: Advanced solar power and energy efficiency solutions, including solar energy generation, storage, energy management systems, and sustainability consulting, delivered to commercial, industrial, and governmental clients.

products.name: Cloud-Based Human Capital Management (HCM) Solution
products.description: A comprehensive, cloud-based SaaS platform that manages the entire employment lifecycle, including payroll, talent acquisition, talent management, HR management, and time and labor management. Delivered digitally via a single database, requiring no on-premises infrastructure.

products.name: Payroll and Payroll Tax Management Services
products.description: Automated payroll processing and payroll tax management services, including payroll calculation, tax deposits, regulatory filings, and payroll-related compliance. Delivered digitally through the SaaS platform, with features like Beti (employee self-service payroll), Paycom Pay, and Vault Visa Payroll Card.

products.name: Talent Acquisition Applications
products.description: Digital tools for recruiting, applicant tracking, onboarding, background checks, E-Verify, and tax credit processing, enabling clients to manage hiring processes efficiently through the SaaS platform.

products.name: Talent Management Applications
products.description: Suite of digital tools for employee self-service, compensation budgeting, performance management, position management, learning management (Paycom Learning), and certification management, all delivered via the SaaS platform to support employee development and engagement.

products.name: HR Management Applications
products.description: Digital HR management tools including Manager on-the-Go, analytics (Direct Data Exchange), employee communications (Ask Here, MyCom), document management, compliance, benefits administration, COBRA administration, personnel action forms, surveys, retirement reporting, and reporting tools. Delivered via the SaaS platform.

products.name: Time and Labor Management Applications
products.description: Digital tools for time and attendance tracking, employee scheduling, automated time-off requests (GONE), and labor allocation, integrated with payroll and accessible via web and mobile devices.

products.name: Expense Management Tools
products.description: Digital expense management and reimbursement tools that automate expense submission, approval, and integration with payroll, including features like receipt uploads and mileage tracking.

products.name: Agency Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities (Agency RMBS)
products.description: Investments in mortgage-backed securities backed by pools of residential mortgage loans and guaranteed by U.S. government-sponsored enterprises. These are acquired through direct purchases and to-be-announced (TBA) contracts, and require financial capital and active portfolio management.

products.name: Agency Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (Agency CMBS)
products.description: Investments in mortgage-backed securities backed by pools of commercial mortgage loans, primarily multifamily housing, and guaranteed by U.S. government-sponsored enterprises. These require financial capital and are managed for yield and risk.

products.name: Non-Agency Mortgage-Backed Securities (Non-Agency MBS)
products.description: Investments in mortgage-backed securities not guaranteed by government-sponsored enterprises, including both residential and commercial MBS, typically in higher quality senior or mezzanine classes. These require financial capital and credit analysis.

products.name: Interest-Only Mortgage-Backed Securities (IO MBS)
products.description: Investments in interest-only securities issued as part of RMBS or CMBS securitizations, representing the right to receive a portion of monthly interest payments on the underlying mortgage pools. These are both Agency and non-Agency issued and require financial capital and risk management.

products.name: Linear Programming Networks
products.description: Operation of branded cable television networks (AMC, We TV, BBCA, IFC, SundanceTV) delivering original and acquired scripted and unscripted series, movies, and special programming to subscribers via traditional pay-TV distributors. Content is produced in-house and licensed from third parties, distributed through regulated, infrastructure-heavy cable and satellite systems.

products.name: Subscription Streaming Services
products.description: Direct-to-consumer and third-party distributed digital streaming platforms (AMC+, Acorn TV, Shudder, Sundance Now, ALLBLK, HIDIVE, All Reality) offering curated, genre-focused, and original video content to subscribers globally. Delivered digitally via proprietary apps and partner platforms, requiring digital infrastructure and content licensing/production.

products.name: Content Licensing
products.description: Licensing of owned and controlled original and acquired television series, films, and franchises to third-party platforms, networks, and international distributors. Involves production, rights management, and negotiation with external parties for global distribution.

products.name: Film Distribution
products.description: Acquisition and distribution of independent, genre, and auteur-focused films under brands such as Independent Film Company, RLJE Films, and Shudder, including theatrical releases, digital, and home video. Involves film acquisition, marketing, and multi-platform distribution.

products.name: International Programming Channels
products.description: Operation and distribution of branded television channels and streaming services outside the U.S. (AMCNI), including local and regional channels in genres such as sports, film, cooking, lifestyle, crime, science, documentary, and kids. Delivered via local pay-TV, free-to-air, and digital platforms, often with local production and language adaptation.

products.name: Anime Content Production and Distribution
products.description: Acquisition, production, and global distribution of anime content through Sentai Holdings and affiliates (HIDIVE, The Anime Network, Sentai Filmworks), including first-run simulcasts, catalog titles, and licensing to commercial partners. Delivered digitally and via linear channels, requiring specialized content acquisition and localization.

products.name: Thermoplastic Corrugated Pipe
products.description: Manufacture and sale of high performance thermoplastic corrugated pipe (single, double, triple wall) made from HDPE and PP, used for stormwater and drainage applications in construction, infrastructure, and agriculture. Produced via extrusion and distributed through a national network.

products.name: Onsite Septic and Decentralized Wastewater Systems (Infiltrator)
products.description: Design and manufacture of engineered plastic chambers, synthetic aggregate leachfields, combined treatment and dispersal systems, plastic tanks, advanced treatment systems, and accessories for onsite septic and decentralized wastewater treatment, primarily for rural and small community applications. Products are injection or compression molded from recycled materials.

products.name: Stormwater Retention, Detention, and Septic Chambers
products.description: Manufacture of injection molded or thermoformed HDPE and PP chambers for underground stormwater retention, detention, and septic system applications, used in residential, non-residential, and public projects. Products are engineered for strength, durability, and efficient storage.

products.name: PVC Drainage Structures
products.description: Production of custom-fabricated PVC drainage structures (inline drains, drain basins, curb inlets, water control structures) for site development, road construction, and landscaping, using thermoforming processes for site-specific hydraulic requirements.

products.name: Fittings and Couplings
products.description: Manufacture of blow molded, injection molded, and custom fabricated fittings and couplings for connecting pipe products, offering both soil-tight and water-tight capabilities across a range of diameters.

products.name: Water Quality Filters and Separators
products.description: Production and sale of water quality units designed to remove sediment, debris, oils, and suspended solids from stormwater through separation and filtration technologies, supporting regulatory compliance and environmental protection.

products.name: Geotextile and Geosynthetic Products
products.description: Distribution of construction fabrics and geosynthetic products (woven and non-woven PP) for soil stabilization, reinforcement, filtration, separation, erosion control, and sub-surface drainage, sourced through resale agreements.

products.name: Advanced Wastewater Treatment Systems (Residential and Commercial)
products.description: Design and manufacture of advanced treatment systems for residential and commercial decentralized wastewater, including mechanical aeration and modular treatment plants, supporting purification and regulatory compliance. Includes proprietary systems and packaged plants.

products.name: Composite Tanks and Utility Structures
products.description: Manufacture of large fiber-reinforced plastic composite tanks, utility buildings, treatment plant lids, and custom structures using filament winding, resin transfer molding, and vacuum infusion processes, primarily for water and wastewater applications.

products.name: Pump Controls and Electrical Panels
products.description: Design and assembly of pump controllers and electrical control panels for residential, commercial, municipal, and OEM wastewater systems, supporting automation and monitoring of water management infrastructure.

products.name: Other Complementary Drainage and Septic Products
products.description: Sale and distribution of complementary products such as drainage grates, Inserta Tee pipe connections, risers, lids, pump vaults, and miscellaneous accessories for drainage and onsite septic systems, often sourced through resale agreements.

products.name: Lawn Care Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed fertilizers, grass seed, weed, pest and disease control products, and spreaders for consumer lawn care, primarily under the Scotts and Turf Builder brands. These are physical goods produced in company facilities and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Gardening and Landscape Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed plant foods, potting mixes, garden soils, ground cover, mulches, and organic gardening products for flower and vegetable gardens, under brands such as Miracle-Gro, Scotts, Hyponex, Earthgro, and Whitney Farms. These are physical products produced and distributed via retail and direct channels.

products.name: Pest and Weed Control Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed insect, rodent, and weed control products for home and garden use, under brands such as Ortho, Tomcat, and Groundclear. These are regulated chemical and physical products distributed through retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Hydroponic and Indoor Gardening Nutrients and Media
products.description: Manufactured and marketed growing media and nutrient products for hydroponic and indoor gardening, under brands such as General Hydroponics, Botanicare, Mother Earth, and CYCO. These are specialized physical products for controlled environment agriculture, distributed to retailers and growers.

products.name: Hydroponic Hardware and Growing Environments
products.description: Manufactured and marketed durable goods such as trays, fans, filters, humidifiers, dehumidifiers, water pumps, and irrigation supplies for hydroponic and indoor gardening, under brands like Botanicare, CAN-FAN, CAN-FILTERS, EcoPlus, Gro Pro, and Hydro-Logic. These are physical products for controlled environment agriculture.

products.name: Lighting Systems for Indoor and Hydroponic Gardening
products.description: Manufactured and marketed lighting systems and components, including controls, fixtures, cords, and hangars, for use in hydroponic and indoor gardening, primarily under the Gavita brand. These are specialized electrical products for plant growth environments.

products.name: Marketing and Distribution Services for Consumer Roundup Products
products.description: Exclusive agent for marketing and distribution of Monsanto’s consumer Roundup branded products in the U.S. and certain other countries, providing marketing, sales, merchandising, warehousing, and other support services. This is a service business line based on contractual agreements.

products.name: Live Plants (via Bonnie Plants Joint Venture)
products.description: Equity interest in a joint venture focused on planting, growing, developing, distributing, marketing, and selling live plants. These are physical, perishable products distributed through retail and other channels.

products.name: Land Development
products.description: Development and sale of residential, commercial, and industrial land, including both developed and undeveloped lots, primarily in New Mexico. Involves site planning, entitlements, installation of utilities, roads, and community amenities, with most development work performed by outside contractors.

products.name: Homebuilding
products.description: Construction and sale of single-family detached and attached homes in New Mexico, offering various floor plans, options, and amenities. Homes are built to order or as speculative inventory, with construction managed by field managers and performed by subcontractors.

products.name: Landscaping Services
products.description: Provision of landscaping services, primarily to homebuilders, as part of the land development and property improvement process. Services are delivered by company employees or contractors.

products.name: Mineral Rights Leasing or Sales
products.description: Ownership and potential sale or leasing of mineral rights in approximately 55,000 surface acres of land in Sandoval County, New Mexico. These rights may be monetized through transactions with third parties.

products.name: Wreckers
products.description: Manufactured bodies for light-duty and heavy-duty wreckers, used to recover and tow disabled vehicles and other equipment. Production involves cutting, bending, and welding steel or aluminum, with assembly of hydraulic and mechanical components, and installation on truck chassis.

products.name: Car Carriers
products.description: Manufactured flat-bed vehicle bodies with hydraulic tilt mechanisms, enabling transport of new or disabled vehicles and other equipment. Delivered as bodies for installation on truck chassis, with customization options for length and features.

products.name: Transport Trailers
products.description: Manufactured multi-vehicle auto transport trailers with hydraulic ramps and upper/lower decks, designed for moving multiple vehicles for auto auctions, dealerships, and similar applications. Built using steel fabrication and hydraulic systems.
